# Semantic layout goldens

`semantic-layout.graph.json` contains all nine coordinate-free models. These are conceptual fixtures, not claims about a running business system. `semantic-layout.test.mjs` checks their facts, layout constraints, repeated compilation, array permutation and compilation of compiled output. Geometry changes require a reason and review; the tests do not blindly accept a new snapshot.

| Diagram | Notation basis | Fixture and project assertions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| architecture | [C4 notation](https://c4model.com/diagrams/notation); responsibility and boundary descriptions, not a prescribed coordinate system | External client, grouped gateway/business services, cache/database layers; explicit ranks; unique ownership; 48px safety clearance and 64px target peer spacing. |
| flowchart | [ISO 5807 scope](https://www.iso.org/standard/11955.html); only the documented project symbol subset is claimed | Decision, both outcomes, actual join, outside retry; the main path must run downward in auto, preserve and export. Optional primaryPath/rank cannot bypass direction checks for a simple chain. Branch corridors stay left/right. No full ISO conformance claim. |
| sequence | [OMG UML 2.5.1](https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/2.5.1), supported interaction subset | Complete participant permutation, paired calls/returns, self call, nested execution, loop→alt and opt→par; message order and identities preserved while `messageY` changes spacing. Parallel operand positions do not claim runtime serialization. |
| er | [IBM ERD](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/entity-relationship-diagram), selected Crow's Foot style | Associative entity with all declared fields/keys; both cardinalities; 28px endpoint space; no inferred foreign keys. |
| deployment | [C4 deployment](https://c4model.com/diagrams/deployment) and supported UML deployment elements | Network→cluster→host ownership; artifacts/services inside their declared boundary; external client outside; dependency edges never create ownership. |
| class | [OMG UML 2.5.1](https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/2.5.1), supported class relationships | Interface above implementation; full members; composition diamond at source; declared source/target multiplicities in geometry and SVG. |
| state | [OMG UML 2.5.1](https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/2.5.1), supported state machine subset | Initial/final, lifecycle, choice, failure/recovery and self loop; event/guard/action retained; no invented composite state semantics. |
| usecase | [OMG UML 2.5.1](https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/2.5.1), supported actor/use-case relationships | Actors outside the system; two base cases share an included case; extension direction unchanged; full bilingual ellipse labels. |
| dataflow | [IBM DFD](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/data-flow-diagram), chosen Gane–Sarson style | Processing stages, adjacent storage, data feedback, open storage symbol; component data flows retain direct relationships between external entities and stores without adding a process. Symbols are inspired by Gane–Sarson; strict pure-DFD endpoint restrictions do not apply. |

Font sizes, canvas budgets, spacing constants, candidate counts and downward hierarchy are QGraphFlow project rules, not universal diagram standards. Source semantics of include/extend or whole/part cannot be proved from coordinates.

The regression suite also covers K3,3 as an accepted nonplanar model, accepted point crossings, shared-endpoint remote crossings, repeated intersections, long shared segments, 23px/24px parallel channels, 47px/48px node clearance, pseudo-multiline rows, malformed ownership/path/order hints, long Chinese/English content, reversed class ranks and direct component data flows and invalid DFD references/edge kinds. The original hybrid-cache row geometry and input hashes remain in the change's `implementation-preflight.md` and its referenced isolated evidence directory.

Rendering and native-host checks are separate acceptance work. A successful Node test is not proof of browser glyph bounds, real image downloads, native save/fullscreen or physical touch behavior.

Geometry review, 2026-09-17: the baseline was updated after viewing all nine actual light-theme PNG exports under `output/playwright/semantic-layout-FxBzVh/final-matrix/exports/`. The changes allocate opposite decision ports, preserve downward branch targets using feedback-edge priorities, widen the second set of candidate channels to 48px, and slide labels off unrelated edge crossings. Node/edge/group geometry was compared with the reviewed export input before replacing the baseline. This records geometry review only; the full interaction acceptance remains incomplete.

State geometry review, 2026-09-17: after actual SVG/PNG exports in `output/playwright/semantic-layout-FxBzVh/component-release-state/`, the state baseline alone was updated for explicit first/last symbol layers and outward feedback routing. The initial successor remains in the first lifecycle layer, including stopped/running cycles. All original transitions remain. Endpoint descriptions, when present, render beside the solid symbol and are included in size, route-clearance and actual-glyph checks. The displayed model and freshly compiled fixture geometry were compared before this update.

Adaptive spacing review, 2026-09-18: all nine actual light-theme PNG exports in `output/playwright/spacing/browser-zh/exports/` were visually inspected before updating `semantic-layout.geometry.json` to `adaptive-v2-elkjs-0.11.0`. Their node, edge and group geometry was compared exactly with fresh compilation of the source fixture. Titles occupy measured top bands with fixed side insets; message labels wrap without truncation; sequence spacing is local while activation nesting, pair IDs/colors, loop→alt and opt→par remain visible. Compared with the previous compilation, fixture bounds area decreases by 17–56% without dropping model facts. Browser and export results are recorded separately from deterministic source tests.
